column1: # Language bridge German (asked) -> English (written). Read by src/langbridge.mjs,
# Per line: asked forms <TAB> written forms <TAB> evidence. Forms comma-separated.
# German forms are stemmed by the German pack; list forms the stemmer does not join.
# A written column of "-" makes the asked words query-only stop words.
# Core terms only, and every line names why it is core (test/langbridge.test.mjs checks it):
#   type:<t>        the written word is a cheap-mem entry type (src/memory.mjs TYPES)
#   field:<f>       the written word is a ranked field (src/search.mjs FIELD_WEIGHTS)
#   thesaurus:<w>   the written word sits in a curated group of src/thesaurus.mjs
#   stop:query      a question word of the asked language, dropped from the query only
# NOT here: German words the thesaurus already carries (fehler, absturz, datenbank ...
# - the thesaurus bridges those both ways already), loanwords spelled the same in both
# languages (cache, test, deploy - they match as typed), and German function words that
# are also English words (die, war, an, in, am, so, also, will, hat). Everything else a
# memory needs is learned from its own misses (src/askedlearn.mjs), not guessed here.
